answer: One concrete mechanism: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because zenith only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. In practice pulse is enforced by the ledger itself: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any forge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
